description: This Java class defines a log filter named MessageOnlyLogFilter that implements the LogNode interface. Its purpose is to filter logging messages to only output the message content, omitting other metadata such as priority, tags, or exceptions. The class allows chaining of log nodes via the mNext member, facilitating log message processing pipelines.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A log filter class that outputs only the message part of log entries.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that takes the next LogNode to chain logs to.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Filters the log message and forwards it to the next LogNode, if any.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
